name: TextArena
summary: MIT framework of 100+ text-based games for evaluating and training language-model agents, with a PyPI package and public site.
description: Established open project (canonical repo TextArena/TextArena; not archived; created 2024-09-23; not presented as a 2026 launch). Root LICENSE is MIT (Copyright 2025 Leon Guertler and Bobby Cheng). PyPI textarena 0.7.4 verified 2026-11-13 (not yanked; wheels uploaded 2025-10-16; homepage https://www.textarena.ai/). The official install is pip install textarena. There were no GitHub Releases on 2026-11-13; the repo was last pushed 2026-10-05. The README on main describes later updates that post-date the PyPI upload, including 192-language support announced 2026-08-14; this entry does not claim those README updates are already in the 0.7.4 wheels. README and the public site describe 100+ single-, two-, and multi-player text games with a Gym-style interface for evaluation, self-play and RL. https://textarena.ai/ permanently redirects (308) to https://www.textarena.ai/ (HTTP 200); the www URL is used here. README examples use an OpenRouter API key; no keys were supplied and no games were run. Model-API and compute costs are separate.

agent_access.notes: Python package: pip install textarena (PyPI textarena 0.7.4 as of 2026-11-13). The GitHub README on main may describe features newer than that upload. No API keys were used.

maintainer: TextArena / Leon Guertler and Bobby Cheng
